title: A hotter star of equal size
hook: Change absolute surface temperature and predict ideal blackbody luminosity.
misconception: ideal blackbody luminosity doubles when absolute surface temperature doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply L = 4πR²σT⁴ to compare ideal blackbody luminosity when absolute surface temperature changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a spherical blackbody with fixed radius, L = 4πR²σT⁴. When absolute surface temperature doubles, ideal blackbody luminosity becomes 16 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model L = 4πR²σT⁴; scaling exponent 4. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a spherical blackbody with fixed radius, with a nonzero initial result. If absolute surface temperature triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on ideal blackbody luminosity?
recall.why: Apply L = 4πR²σT⁴ under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 81.
